name: Project Everest (miTLS-fstar, HACL*, EverCrypt, EverParse)
subject: TLS 1.2/1.3 record layer and handshake, QUIC record layer, cryptographic primitives, binary message parsers
tool: F* (Low*, Vale) + Z3 + KaRaMeL; HACL* on frozen F* ref=fstar1 with KaRaMeL bd2d4fa; EverParse Z3 5.3.0
org: Microsoft Research, INRIA, Carnegie Mellon University

tcb.unverified_translator: KaRaMeL (Low* to C), Vale printer, C compiler; F* has no kernel and trusts VC encoding and Z3 (26 soundness bugs found)
tcb.note: admit = mitls-fstar 63 + hacl-star 70 (+1 everparse not summed); assume_val = 174+96+39; admit_smt_queries_true = 125+2+1. miTLS handshake modules use --admit_smt_queries true.

loc.note: Everest total ~1.3M lines F*; HACL* ~245k F*+Vale -> ~135k C+asm; mitls-fstar 57,564 F* lines

pattern: verified implementation in proof language extracted to C/asm; RFC-grammar to verified parser generator; idealised modules as computational security spec
